speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms first began?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any abdominal pain, particularly in the upper right quadrant, or have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool? I would also like to check for any signs of jaundice or rash.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any specific food allergies, and have you consumed unpasteurized dairy products or soft cheeses recently? I will also order some blood work to check for signs of infection or liver involvement. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests
